For an instrumented streaming response, `sentry_raw_stream_close()` calls `_finish_span(span)` directly, then calls `finish_span()` when no read is in progress. That helper also calls `_finish_span(span)`, so closing the raw stream before the body has finished causes the client span to be finished twice; the helper’s `finished` guard does not cover the direct call.
YES
